interpretation.ks_statistic: Lower is more similar; 0 means identical empirical distributions.
interpretation.total_variation_distance: Lower is more similar; 0 means identical category frequencies.
interpretation.exact_match_rate: Lower means fewer synthetic rows copied exactly from the source.
interpretation.nearest_neighbour_distance_ratio: Synthetic-to-real median nearest-neighbour distance divided by the real-to-real equivalent. Values near or below 1 deserve privacy review.
